name: Changsoo Shin
abstract_title: Recursive Heaviside Potentials as Source-Driven Wave Structures in Cognitive Dynamics
abstract: This study develops a mathematical framework in which recursive Heaviside sequence functions are used to model discrete cognitive activation events distributed along an intrinsic time-like coordinate, τ. Each activation behaves as a threshold-triggered switch, and the recursive structure generates a cascade of such switches at progressively deeper levels of cognitive organization.
